test_basic_comment.description: Skips // single-line comments, returns each identifier/operator/number as its own token, terminates on the trailing period with an EOF token.

test_multichar.description: Returns the two-character operators <=, >=, <>, and := as single tokens (not as two separate ones).

test_period_eof.description: A period in the source returns 'EOF' and hasNext() becomes false, so any tokens after the period are not scanned.

test_error_dollar.description: Encountering '$' (an unrecognized character) raises ScanErrorException. Driver catches it and emits an ERROR line; tokens before the bad char appear first.

test_bad_removed.description: Scanner works cleanly once the line containing the unknown character is removed.

test_bad_commented.description: Commenting out the bad character with // makes the scanner skip it; no error and tokens scan cleanly.
